title: Associate Technical Lead
description:
POSITION **SUMMARY**
BOT VFX, a post\-production services company in the entertainment industry with global clients, is looking for a Backend Developer with 3\+ years of experience to design, develop, and maintain scalable software solutions. The role involves leading development tasks, writing clean code, mentoring juniors, and collaborating across teams in an Agile environment with a strong acumen of AI trends and leveraging AI to improve efficiency and quality to the overall process This role reports to the Sr. Architect and dotted line basis to the Product Manager.
POSITION **RESPONSIBILITY****Technical Leadership*** Own the design and architecture of backend services, data models, and integrations, ensuring technical feasibility and adherence to architectural standards.
* Lead code reviews, design reviews, and performance optimization efforts.
* Mentor and guide junior engineers and help raise the team's overall technical capability.
* Translate business and production requirements into scalable technical solutions.

**Backend \& Data Engineering*** Design data models and develop RESTful APIs using Node.js and TypeScript with the NestJS framework.
* Build and maintain data synchronization pipelines between production tracking and pipeline management platforms using Change Data Capture (CDC) and event\-driven patterns.
* Develop spreadsheet\-based integrations (e.g., Google Sheets API) for data import, reporting, and forecasting workflows.
* Manage database migrations across development, staging, and production environments.
* Build and maintain data sync processes between the data warehouse and production databases.
* Implement asynchronous and background job processing using message queues such as RabbitMQ or Redis.
* Administer and optimize PostgreSQL and MySQL databases, covering schema design, indexing, and query tuning.

**AI \& Intelligent Applications*** Build Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) based AI agents for enterprise knowledge and policy search.
* Develop Model Context Protocol (MCP) based tools and integrations that give AI assistants access to production data and insights.

**Quality, Security \& Reliability*** Write clean, modular, reusable, and well\-tested code following best practices.
* Monitor, debug, and resolve complex issues across backend services, data pipelines, and AI systems.
* Ensure compliance with security best practices, data privacy requirements, and secure coding standards.
* Optimize system performance, reliability, and scalability.

**Collaboration*** Work with product managers, developers, pipeline/TD teams, DevOps, and business stakeholders.
* Document architecture, data flows, and technical decisions.

### **Required Skills**

* 5\+ years of experience in backend development, including at least 1–2 years in a lead or senior role.
* Strong proficiency in Node.js and TypeScript with hands\-on experience in NestJS.
* Solid experience in data modeling, API design, and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Experience with Change Data Capture, ETL/ELT pipelines, and data synchronization between systems.
* Working knowledge of data warehousing concepts and syncing data between OLTP and analytical systems.
* Familiarity with AI agent development and tool\-calling, including Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience integrating with third\-party APIs, including Google Workspace APIs (Sheets, Drive).
* Working knowledge of RabbitMQ and Redis for messaging and job queues, and of event\-driven, message\-based architectures.
* Proficiency with Git and version control workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving, communication, and mentoring skills.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Hands\-on experience building LLM\-powered applications: RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate), and frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex.
* Frontend development experience (React or similar) for building internal tools and applications.
* Experience with streaming/CDC tools such as Debezium or Kafka.
* Familiarity with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and Linux/shell scripting.
* Understanding of microservices architecture.
* Experience with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack).
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Experience with testing frameworks such as Jest.
* Exposure to VFX, animation, or media production pipelines is a strong plus.
* Willingness to learn and switch between technologies as needed and to swap between multiple projects simultaneously.

title: Software Development Manager, Amazon Integration Management
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you customer obsessed? Want to build AI\-powered tooling that transforms how developers integrate with Amazon's device ecosystem? Here is an opportunity to showcase your traits as an SDM!  

  

AIM (Apps Integration Management) org is looking for a talented and experienced Software Development Manager who is responsible for leading the Developer Tools team — building the AI\-powered enablement layer that helps developers seamlessly integrate with Amazon's device portfolio. In this role, the SDM will work hands\-on with engineering, product management, and cross\-functional teams to deliver intelligent automation, quality infrastructure, and measurement frameworks while fostering inputs and participation from all levels of the organization.  

  

SDM for this role is responsible for transforming the developer integration experience — significantly reducing integration time through AI\-driven assistance, automated validation, and self\-service tooling. SDM in this role would play a key role in scaling the developer ecosystem without increasing support overhead, and need to operationalize metrics\-driven processes to continuously improve tool adoption, quality, and developer satisfaction.  

  

SDM in this role would work collaboratively with integration teams, feature teams, partner\-facing organizations, and external developers to understand their needs and deliver tooling that eliminates friction, shifts quality left, and enables developers to confidently ship first\-time across Amazon's devices.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of engineering experience
* 3\+ years of engineering team management experience
* 8\+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
* Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
* Experience partnering with product or program management teams
* Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
* Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Associate Product Manager / Product Manager — Over-the-Road Visibility
description:
*At FourKites we have the opportunity to tackle complex challenges with real\-world impacts. Whether it's medical supplies from Cardinal Health or groceries for Walmart, the FourKites platform helps customers operate global supply chains that are efficient, agile and sustainable.*


*Industry Context: AI\-driven supply chain innovations reduce logistics costs by 15%\+, inventory by 35%\+, and improve service efficiency by 65%\+. Companies prioritize AI\-enabled automation as the key enabler for customer experience, sustainability, and resilience.*


*Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.*



FourKites is looking for a sharp, curious and execution\-focused Product Manager to join the Visibility team and own our Over\-the\-Road (OTR) portfolio: Truckload, LTL, Parcel and Last Mile. This is FourKites' flagship product line. Some of the world's largest shippers use it to track billions of dollars of freight every day.



This is not a PM support role. You will own real product outcomes from day one. You'll work hands\-on with data, build your own prototypes, talk directly with enterprise customers, and partner with engineering and design to ship features that improve adoption, retention and tracking quality.



The role sits where supply chain operations meet modern software product development, and you'll need both. You need deep empathy for how freight actually moves across modes, and the analytical rigor to turn that into product bets worth making.


##### **What you'll be doing**


**Product Ownership \& Outcomes**


* Own product outcomes for one or more OTR modes (Truckload, LTL, Parcel or Last Mile), including tracking quality, ETA accuracy and carrier coverage.
* Track and analyze adoption, engagement and retention KPIs for your area.
* Find friction points and adoption gaps using usage data, customer interviews and feedback from Customer Success and Sales.
* Build and prioritize a backlog that measurably improves customer stickiness, and bring well\-reasoned prioritization recommendations to roadmap planning.


**Data \& AI\-Assisted Product Development**


* Write your own SQL to explore feature usage, tracking performance and customer behavior, without waiting on an analyst.
* Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor and similar) to build working prototypes, internal tools and quick analyses that make a requirement concrete before engineering picks it up.
* Work hands\-on in product analytics platforms like Pendo, and maintain dashboards that track adoption trends across customer segments.
* Turn quantitative findings into clear product hypotheses and actionable backlog items.
* Partner with Data Science and Engineering on instrumentation and event tracking.


**Customer Engagement**


* Run discovery sessions and join onboarding calls, QBRs and support escalations to understand shipper and carrier workflows firsthand.
* Work with Customer Success Managers to surface systemic product gaps and recurring pain points.
* Represent the voice of the customer in internal planning and sprint reviews.


**Cross\-Functional Execution**


* Work with Engineering and Design through scoping, development and post\-launch monitoring, partnering directly with squads across time zones.
* Support Product Marketing with onboarding materials, release notes and adoption playbooks.
* Contribute to presales conversations and market requirements gathering with Solutions teams.


**Who you are**



We're hiring at two levels:


* **Associate Product Manager:** 2–4 years in product management or a related role. Strong BA, analyst, solutions or implementation backgrounds in logistics tech are welcome.
* **Product Manager:** 5\+ years, including end\-to\-end ownership of a product area and a track record of shipping with measurable business impact.


For both levels:


* Practical experience in supply chain or logistics. You understand shipper pain points, carrier dynamics and how freight moves day to day.
* Comfort working hands\-on with data: strong SQL, familiarity with analytics tools, and the ability to build a data\-driven story on your own.
* Proven use of AI tools to speed up PM work beyond drafting documents, such as building prototypes, scripts and internal tools yourself. Be ready to walk us through something you've built this way.
* Strong customer engagement skills. You've run discovery calls, written user stories, and can turn qualitative feedback into crisp requirements.
* Experience working with distributed engineering teams across time zones.
* Ability to work with significant overlap with US Central Time.


**Preferred Qualifications:**


* Experience with two or more of truckload, LTL, parcel and last mile.
* Prior work on SaaS onboarding flows, feature adoption programs or customer health scoring.
* Experience with Pendo, Amplitude or similar product analytics tools.
* Familiarity with agile development and working directly with engineering squads.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, economics or another quantitative field.


**What success looks like in year 1:**


* You independently own a product area within OTR visibility, with clear adoption and engagement KPIs.
* You've shipped customer\-facing improvements end to end, from discovery through post\-launch analysis, with significant business impact.
* You use data to find insights before anyone has to ask for them.
* You've built prototypes or internal tools that changed how a requirement was scoped or how your team works.
* Customer Success and Engineering see you as a reliable, high\-signal partner.


**Who we are:**


*FourKites, the leader in AI\-driven supply chain transformation for global enterprises and pioneer of real\-time visibility, turns supply chain data into automated action. FourKites Intelligent Control Tower® breaks down enterprise silos by creating a real\-time digital twin of orders, shipments, inventory and assets. This comprehensive view, combined with AI\-powered digital workers, enables companies to prevent disruptions, automate routine tasks and optimize performance across their supply chain. FourKites processes over 3\.2 million supply chain events daily — from purchase orders to final delivery — helping 1,600\-plus global brands prevent disruptions, make faster decisions and move from reactive tracking to proactive supply chain orchestration. For more information, visit* *www.fourkites.com**.*



FourKites provides competitive compensation with stock options, outstanding benefits and a collaborative culture for all employees around the globe. To help you be your best, we have 5 global recharge days, in addition to generous PTO and standard holidays. Parental leave for all parents, an annual wellness stipend and volunteer days also provide you with time and resources for self care and to care for others. Throughout the year, FourKites sets aside time during the workday to learn and celebrate diversity. We're always listening for new ways to support everyone in and out of the office.


**Benefits:**


* Medical benefits start on first day of employment
* 36 PTO days (Sick, Casual and Earned), 5 recharge days, 2 volunteer days
* Home office setup and technology reimbursement
* Lifestyle \& family benefits
* Mental wellness support and guidance
* Ongoing learning \& development opportunities (Professional Development Program, Toastmasters Club, etc.)

title: Director, Demand Generation
description:
**About Rocketlane**
--------------------


Rocketlane is redefining how professional services teams operate. With the launch of **Nitro**, our AI platform for Professional Services and Delivery teams, we've introduced agents (like the Migration Agent, Documentation Agent, Workforce Agent, and Signals) that fundamentally change what PS teams can accomplish. Nitro doesn't just automate work; it shows what's possible when AI is built into the fabric of how services are delivered.


We're not chasing the crowded install base. We're creating a new category, and we need someone who knows how to make a market believe in something before it's obvious.


**The Role**
------------


This is not a playbook\-execution job.


The traditional demand gen toolkit (Google Ads, webinars, event sponsorships) won't build the market we need. Our buyers (VPs of Professional Services) don't convert from a gated white paper. They convert when they *see* something that makes them think: "I had no idea that was possible."


Your job is to make them see it.


You'll own the full demand strategy for Nitro: discovering new channels before they're saturated, producing content that earns attention in an age where attention is the scarcest resource, and building a repeatable engine for channel exploration, not channel management.


You run experiments, not campaigns. You find channels, you don't inherit them.


**What You'll Own**
-------------------


**Market Education \& Category Creation**


* Build the narrative around what AI\-native professional services *looks like*, using Nitro's Migration Agent and other agents as proof points
* Create content (especially visual/video) that shows possibilities, not just features
* Make VP PS the audience that forwards your stuff to their peers

**Channel Experimentation**


* Design a structured test\-and\-learn system to identify emerging, non\-obvious demand channels: dark social, niche communities, LinkedIn creator plays, short\-form video, practitioner\-led content
* Kill failing experiments fast; scale winners before they become crowded
* Maintain an active "channel hypothesis backlog" and always be running the next test

**Pipeline Creation**


* Drive qualified pipeline into sales through a mix of inbound pull and targeted ABX for high\-value PS leader accounts
* Partner closely with Sales to calibrate ICP, signal quality, and follow\-up sequencing
* Own the funnel metrics that matter: awareness velocity, ICP engagement, pipeline influenced, sales cycle acceleration

**Brand in Market**


* Position Rocketlane as the definitive voice in AI\-for\-PS, not just a tool vendor
* Build an external presence for Rocketlane's founders and subject\-matter experts as trusted voices in the PS community

**The Profile We're Looking For**
---------------------------------


### **The 2026 Demand Leader Is Different**


The old model (hire someone who managed $5M in Google Ads and ran quarterly webinars) is broken. The attention economy has made buyers immune to that playbook. We're looking for someone who has shown a consistent pattern of finding channels *before* they peak, extracting outsized value, and moving on before they become noise.


**You've got at least 2 big wins under your belt.** Not "contributed to growth." You *drove* something: a new channel that wasn't in the plan, a campaign that became the company's signature move, a GTM motion that others later tried to copy. You can tell the story in 60 seconds and back it up with numbers.


**You have a framework for finding and killing ideas fast.** A hypothesis backlog, a bias for cheap tests, and a ruthless ability to read signal from noise early. You've killed your own ideas before leadership told you to.


**You live in the attention economy.** You understand why a 90\-second LinkedIn video from a practitioner can outperform $50k in paid ads. You've used dark social, community seeding, and creator distribution, not because you read about them, but because you've run them.


**You've marketed something people didn't know they needed.** Category creation, new product category, or a feature set that required explaining the problem before selling the solution. You know what it feels like to market upstream of demand.


**You're a builder, not just a manager.** At our stage, the Head of Demand Gen writes copy, tests ads themselves, gets on calls with practitioners to understand the persona, and ships things without a full team behind them.
  

  

**You execute with a high quality bar.** You have taste and judgment for what great looks like. When you back an idea or hypothesis, you do it justice ensuring there's real confidence that it's been explored to its fullest potential, not just checked off the list.


**Must\-Have Experience**
-------------------------


* 7\-12 years in demand generation (B2B SaaS preferred, but strong B2C candidates with a track record of channel experimentation and audience building are equally welcome), with at least 2 stints where you were a key driver of measurable growth inflection
* Demonstrated ability to discover and exploit new/underused channels, with specific examples from at least 2 different companies (the same channel trick twice doesn't count)
* Experience marketing to senior buyers (VP / C\-suite) in enterprise or mid\-market B2B
* Proven track record with content\-led or video\-led demand motions, not just paid search
* Hands\-on experience with modern GTM tooling: Clay, HubSpot or equivalent, LinkedIn paid, intent data, influencer marketing, attribution approaches for dark social
* Strong creative judgment: you can brief a video, write a hook, and know when something will land

**Nice to Have**
----------------


* Marketed an AI product, especially one that required educating the market on new possibilities rather than competing on features
* Experience at a company that grew through a "show don't tell" motion (demo\-led, video\-first, or practitioner\-community\-led)
* Background in or exposure to the PS / consulting / implementation world
* Built UGC or customer\-voice content programs
* Managed a small team or agency pod while also being personally hands\-on

### **What We Won't Hire**


* Someone who optimizes existing channels exceptionally well but hasn't *created* demand from new ones
* A "demand gen operator" whose primary skill is campaign setup and reporting
* Anyone whose answer to "how do you find new channels" is "I read industry reports and benchmark against competitors"
* Someone who needs 6 months to develop a strategy before testing anything

### **What Success Looks Like**


**90 days:** You've run 3\-5 channel experiments, identified 1\-2 high\-signal channels to double down on, and have a clear point of view on how Rocketlane Nitro should show up in market.


**6 months:** A repeatable demand motion is live. VP PS leaders in ICP accounts know Rocketlane and associate us with what AI\-native PS looks like. Pipeline from non\-traditional channels is measurable and growing.


**12 months:** Rocketlane is the brand that VP PS professionals cite when talking about AI transforming their function. You've built a channel playbook others would try to replicate.


### **Why This Role Is Special**


* You'll be working directly with the founders, with no 3\-layer approval chains
* You have a real product story to tell. Nitro's Migration Agent is genuinely new. The possibilities aren't marketing spin; they're real
* You'll have budget and latitude to experiment, not just optimize
* This is a category\-creation moment. The person who builds this playbook writes the case study that others reference for years

  

**Why join us?**


At Rocketlane, we’re all about building a great product and a great place to work. Here’s why you’ll actually look forward to Mondays:


* Impact and ownership: You won’t just be another cog in the machine; here, you’re more like a turbocharged engine part. Bring your ideas, make them happen.
* Work with the best: We’re a team of passionate, quirky, and ridiculously talented people. Come for the work, stay for the memes.
* Celebrate wins: Whether we’re hitting major milestones or celebrating new funding, we like to mix it up. From rap videos to team outings, we believe in celebrating big.
* Learn and grow: We’re all about learning—and we’re not just talking about the latest SaaS trends. You’ll grow your career, pick up new skills, and maybe even learn to love Excel (or at least tolerate it).
* Flexibility and balance: While we love collaborating in the office five days a week, we know everyone has their own rhythm. That’s why we offer flexibility around hours—so you can bring your best energy, whether you’re an early bird or a night owl. Pajamas optional (at least outside the office).
  

  

*Rocketlane is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to building a team where everyone can do their best work.*

title: Product Manager
description:
**About Rocketlane**


Rocketlane is a fast\-growing SaaS company redefining how B2B companies run professional services. Our platform powers customer onboarding and project delivery for some of the most demanding teams in SaaS \- from Glean and Intercom to Atlassian and Notion. We're a team of 100\+ backed by $45M from Insight Partners, 8VC, Matrix Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners, and we're building in a space where AI is fundamentally reshaping how services teams work.


**The Role**


We're looking for a Senior Product Manager who thinks in systems, builds in prototypes, and ships with urgency. This isn't a role for people who write PRDs and hand them off. It's for someone who can go from a customer conversation to a working proof of concept in days, not sprints.


You'll work directly with our founding team across the full product lifecycle. From identifying what to build, to designing AI\-powered workflows, to getting them into customers' hands.


**What You'll Do**


**Build first, spec second.** You'll prototype ideas using AI\-powered tools like Lovable, Claude, and Cursor to create working demos before a single line of production code is written. Engineers should be able to pick up where you left off.


**Own AI feature development end\-to\-end.** Identify where AI agents, LLMs, automation can eliminate friction in professional services workflows. Define the interaction, design the feedback loops, prompt\-engineer the underlying behavior, and drive it through to launch.


**Be the person closest to the problem.** Spend significant time with customers. Not just in discovery calls, but in their workflows. Translate messy, real\-world service delivery problems into product that actually changes how they work.


**Think in systems, not features.** Design workflows and feedback loops, not one\-off capabilities. Ask how the system learns, improves, and scales \- not just how it handles the happy path.


**Drive go\-to\-market as a product artifact.** Work with product marketing to turn launches into moments. Build demo environments, write product narratives, and make sure what ships also lands.


**Work across every function.** Engineering, design, CS, sales, support \- you're the connective tissue. You'll influence without authority and move fast without breaking things (usually).


**What We're Looking For**


**Must\-haves**


* 4 \- 6 years of product management experience, preferably in B2B SaaS
* Hands\-on experience building functional prototypes \- with Lovable, Cursor, Claude, Bolt, or similar tools. We mean actually building, not just evaluating
* Comfort working with AI systems: you understand prompt design, LLM limitations, evaluations and how to design human\-in\-the\-loop workflows
* Strong systems thinking: you design for the edge cases, the audit trail, the rollback, not just the happy path
* High agency: you figure things out, you don't wait for someone to unblock you
* Sharp written communication: your Slack message should be as clear as your spec

**Strong signals we look for**


* You've shipped features at a pace that made your engineering team nervous (in a good way)
* You've built something with Lovable, Claude Code, or Cursor that went beyond a toy, it was demoed to customers or used internally
* You have experience in or strong intuition for complex B2B workflows (PSA, ERP, finance, project management, CRM)
* You've designed conversational UX or agentic product experiences. You know the difference between a good agent interaction and a bad one
* You've used AI to do your own job better: research, synthesis, spec writing, competitive analysis

**What's Different About This Role**


At Rocketlane, you're not joining a mature PM org with established playbooks. You're one of a small team working directly with the founders. The problems are hard, the customers are sophisticated, and the standard is high. You'll be expected to move faster than feels comfortable — and to use every tool available to you to do it.


The upside: your fingerprints will be on the product. The features you ship will be used by some of the best professional services teams in SaaS.

The Mid\-Corp Relationship Manager is a strategic professional who closely follows latest trends in own field and adapts them for application within own job and the business. Typically a small number of people within the business that provide the same level of expertise. Excellent communication skills required in order to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers.
